name: risk-profile
title: Risk profile
for_each: select id,reference from risks where status<>'closed'

sections.title: Risk
sections.sql: select reference,title,category,owner,inherent_score as inherent,residual_score as residual,rating,appetite_score as appetite,next_review_on from risk_register where id=$1

sections.title: Description
sections.sql: select description from risks where id=$1

sections.title: Controls
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,kind,effectiveness,last_tested_on from controls where risk_id=$1 and status='active' order by reference

sections.title: Treatment actions
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,due_on,status from actions where risk_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Rating history
sections.sql: select reviewed_on,reviewer,residual_likelihood*residual_consequence as residual,note from risk_reviews where risk_id=$1 order by reviewed_on desc

sections.title: Incident
sections.note: Internal record. A regulator or privacy notice is a separate step, drafted with draft-notification and sent by a person.

sections.title: What happened
sections.sql: select description,root_cause from incidents where id=$1

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,due_on,status,completed_on from actions where incident_id=$1 order by due_on

name: obligations-register
title: Compliance obligations register
for_each: select true as id,name from organisation

sections.title: Obligations and attestations
sections.sql: select reference,title,source,owner,last_attested_on,last_outcome,next_due_on from obligation_queue where $1::boolean order by reference
